criteria.force_push: Push while overwriting the remote branch's history with the local version.
criteria.init: Create a new Git repository in this folder.
criteria.add_remote: Add or set the URL of a remote repository.
criteria.find_lost_work: Search for and recover lost or deleted commits.
criteria.remotes: List the configured remote repositories and their URLs.
criteria.stash_pop: Bring back the most recently stashed changes into the working tree.
criteria.pull_rebase: Pull the remote's commits and replay my local commits on top of them (rebase instead of merge).
criteria.set_upstream: Make the current branch track a branch on the remote.
criteria.remove_remote: Remove a configured remote from this repository.
criteria.delete_repo: Delete this folder's Git repository (the .git directory), keeping the files.
criteria.__reject__: Not a request about Git or version control at all.

op.label: checkout
